The '''Lunar Gardens''' was a legendary garden located on the [[Useria's moon|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Useria]] that was in ruins by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Excavation of the Gardens uncovered a cache of rare biological specimens.
